tasks.title: Implement auto-prune of empty parent directories on archive in SpecManager
tasks.description: In src/manager/spec_manager.rs, update archive() so that after moving the feature to target_path, any empty parent directories inside projects/active are pruned ascending towards projects/active root.

tasks.title: Implement SpecManager::clean and SpecManager::abort
tasks.description: In src/manager/spec_manager.rs, implement clean() to recursively prune empty directories within projects/active, and abort() to delete an active feature folder, clear .spec_last_used if matching, and prune empty parent folders.

tasks.title: Add Clean and Abort CLI subcommands and dispatch in main.rs
tasks.description: In src/cli/commands.rs, add Clean and Abort subcommands to Commands enum. In src/main.rs, wire up dispatch to manager.clean and manager.abort.

tasks.title: Expose sc_clean and sc_abort MCP tools in server.rs
tasks.description: In src/mcp/server.rs, define ScClean and ScAbort tool structs with macros, register them in handle_list_tools_request, and dispatch them in handle_call_tool_request.

tasks.title: Comprehensive unit tests, version bump, and release build verification
tasks.description: Add unit tests verifying archive pruning, clean, and abort in tests/. Bump version in Cargo.toml to 0.1.19. Verify full test suite passes with cargo test and cargo build --release.
